description: Synthetic sesslint.checks.context_pressure parity (stdlib-only vectors; no session payload text).
known_parity_gaps: A real under-15% marker calls make_finding with the fingerprint omitted. Rust returns FINGERPRINT_CODEC_UNAVAILABLE. Python emits a finding (known gap).
Python int is unbounded. Rust checked i64 overflow on window - occupancy, headroom * 20, and window * 3 is PYTHON_INT_UNBOUNDED.
A bool is not an int.
MapLookup::Borrowed is a failed borrow, not a missing key.
